CustomField.description: Board width x length with the unit, without trailing zeros. Blank when width or length is missing.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(PCB_Board_Width__c), ISBLANK(PCB_Board_Length__c)), "", TEXT(PCB_Board_Width__c) & " × " & TEXT(PCB_Board_Length__c) & IF(ISBLANK(PCB_Unit_Of_Measure__c), "", " " & PCB_Unit_Of_Measure__c))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Board width × length with the unit. Calculated from Board Width, Board Length and Unit of Measure.
CustomField.label: Board Size
